_doc: Pi-IR projection of parallel_block_indices/messages_sse.json. MIRRORED with pi: both harnesses route deltas by content_block_index to the correct in-flight block. Pi's `blocks` keyed by index (index.ts:1023) and XLI's BlockTracker HashMap (sse/messages.rs) are isomorphic. The fixture starts two text blocks in parallel, interleaves their deltas (index 1's 'second' BEFORE index 0's 'first'), and stops in start-order. Both harnesses produce [text('first'), text('second')] in stop-arrival order. Closes RI-033 (INVARIANT — Parallel content block indices / HI-C5-001).
